title: Rate Card Floor Conflict on Pre-Change Verbal Commitment
question: Tomás wants to close the Apex deal at Q1 CPM floors ($34/$20) citing the verbal commitment and pre-change proposal date. What is the correct pricing decision?

contributor.name: Alexandra Petrov
contributor.title: VP, Advertising Sales Planning & Strategy
contributor.domain_expertise: Upfront marketplace commitments, scatter pricing, audience guarantees, make-good allocation strategy

choices: Restructure the package mix to 45% premium / 55% RON at Q2 floors to match competitive pricing while maintaining rate card compliance
Apply Q2 floor rates ($38/$22) with no exceptions — the rate card explicitly states 'no grandfathering for unsigned proposals' and a verbal commitment has no contractual standing
Apply Q2 floor rates but approve a one-time VP-level exception to discount premium CPM to $34, citing competitive pressure and deal size
Honor Q1 rates — the proposal was sent March 18 before the April 1 floor change, establishing a binding price commitment to the client
